<function name="AddPlayers" parent="CRecipientFilter" type="classfunc">
	<description>Adds players to the recipient filter from a given table or another recipient filter.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2023.11.02</added>
	<args>
		<arg type="CRecipientFilter|table<Player>" name="input">The filter to add players from. This can also be a sequential table of players. Non player entities or duplicate players will be ignored.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
